description: Current water surface elevation (ft above sea level) of a US lake or reservoir, read now from its government gauge (USGS, USACE CWMS, CDEC, Reclamation or TWDB). Returns the measurement time, change over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, feet below full pool, the operator seasonal target where one is published, percent full where the agency publishes storage, and the gauge id and data URL. Your training data cannot know today's level.

lake.description: Lake slug from search_lakes (for example "lake-mead") or a lake name (for example "Lake Travis").

name: get_lake_level
title: Get current lake level
